Completed events are collected here for reference. For upcoming meetings and ongoing seminar series, see [Statistics, ML & AI events](/resources/conferences_seminars/).

# 2026 {#past-2026}

## Atlanta and nearby Georgia

- [Atlanta Mathematics of Data Science Bootcamp](https://wliao60.math.gatech.edu/bootcamp2026/) — **September 19–20 · Georgia Tech, Atlanta.** Tutorials and projects on the mathematical foundations of data science and ML, for undergraduate and high-school students.
- [ACM AI Leadership Summit](https://aisummit26.acm.org/registration/) — **August 31–September 2 · Hyatt Regency Atlanta.** AI research, agentic systems, governance, and applications across academia and industry.
- [FOPAM 2026](https://fopam.cache.org/) — **July 26–30 · Courtyard by Marriott Atlanta Decatur Downtown/Emory, Decatur.** Process and product analytics and machine learning. The [July 26–27 pre-conference workshop](https://dais.chbe.ubc.ca/fopam2026/) connected experimental design and regression with deep learning, LLMs, and AI agents.
- [Summer Institute in Statistics and Modeling in Infectious Diseases (SISMID)](https://sismid.sph.emory.edu/) — **July 13–24 · Emory University, Atlanta.** In-person short courses in statistical and infectious-disease modeling, including ML, MCMC, and simulation-based inference; online modules ran June 22–26.
- [Atlanta Cloud + AI Conference](https://atlcloudconf.com/) — **May 30 · FCS Innovation Academy, Alpharetta.** Practitioner sessions on cloud infrastructure, AI applications, RAG, and model deployment. See the organizer's [2026 event packet](https://atlcloudconf.com/assets/pdfs/ATLCloud%2BAIConf2026-SponsorshipPacket.pdf).
- [STATGEN 2026](https://statgen26.emory.edu/) — **May 18–20 · Emory University, Atlanta.** Statistical genetics and related methodology.
- [11th Workshop on Biostatistics and Bioinformatics](https://math.gsu.edu/yichuan/2026Workshop/) — **May 8–10 · Georgia State University, Atlanta.** Organized by Yichuan Zhao, with research talks, student posters, and a short course.
- [Atlanta AI Week 2026](https://www.joinaiweek.com/atlanta) — **April 20–22 · Atlanta Tech Village, Buckhead.** Enterprise AI, practical workshops, and startup networking.
- [Georgia State Undergraduate Research Conference (GSURC)](https://curci.gsu.edu/gsurc/) — **April 6 · Student Center East, Atlanta.** Undergraduate research, scholarship, and creative projects across disciplines.
- [INFORMS Optimization Society Conference](https://ios2026.isye.gatech.edu/) — **March 20–22 · The Ritz-Carlton, Atlanta.** Optimization for data science, decisions under uncertainty, and computational methods.
- [Computational Cognition Conference (CoCo Con)](https://sciences.gatech.edu/news/computational-cognition-conference-showcases-georgia-techs-advancements-research-related-mind) — **March 13 · Georgia Tech, Atlanta.** Computational approaches to cognition and their connections with AI.

## Elsewhere

- [ASA/IMS Spring Research Conference](https://sites.google.com/view/src2026) — **May 26–28 · Clemson University, South Carolina.** A regional option beyond Georgia for research in statistics and its applications.
- [Design and Analysis of Experiments](https://statistics.rutgers.edu/news-events/conferences/design-and-analysis-of-experiments-2026) — **May 19–21 · Rutgers University, New Jersey.** Research on experimental design and analysis.

# Notes

Updated September 26, 2026. These events had concluded by this update. Dates, venues, and descriptions are retained from the linked organizers' or host institutions' pages; some event websites may later switch to a newer edition.
